name: Gusto
summary: The sandbox is self-serve, but production access is gated and not all applications are approved. Gusto does not publish how long it takes.

gates.title: Create a developer account and sandbox app

blockers.fix: Production access is gated; ask Gusto what is missing before reapplying.

gates.title: Send the Partner Checklist to developer@gusto.com

claims.text: Create a developer portal account, org and app to get a client ID; the sandbox is api.gusto-demo.com only.

sources.quote: Dev portal → org → app → client ID; sandbox api.gusto-demo.com only.

claims.text: Production needs Pre-Approval, then the Partner Checklist, then QA review before production keys. Not all applications are approved.

sources.quote: "Production access is gated, and not all applications are approved" → Partner Checklist to developer@gusto.com → QA review → production keys.

claims.text: Gusto does not publish how long approval takes. Third-party reports of the security review differ (about 1 week vs 2–4 weeks).
claims.note: Reported by Merge (~1 week) and Finch (2–4 weeks); not official, so not used as a number.
